description: This is an HTML file containing a ReactJS application, including embedded JavaScript code that defines React components such as AppHeader, NewBook, ColorButton, BookItem, BookList, and the main App component. It also includes script tags to load React and ReactDOM libraries, with application logic for a reading list interface.

classes.name: NewBook
classes.description: React component for creating new book entries, managing an input state.

classes.name: BookItem
classes.description: React component representing a single book item.

classes.name: BookList
classes.description: React component displaying a list of books.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React application component managing the reading list and rendering sub-components.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles input events in the NewBook component to update local state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React components for NewBook, BookList, and others within the App component.

methods.name: onNewBook
methods.description: Function to add a new book to the reading list, updating the component's state.
